sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Gomal Zam Project Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

GOMAL ZAM PROJECT (CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN LAND)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
GOMAL ZAM PROJECT
(CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF SPECULATION IN LAND) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Gomal Zam Project (Control and
Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 15th January, 2002]
No. legis.1(28)71/312-17.,
dated 15-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the North-West Frontier Province Gonial Zam Project (Control and Prevention of
Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XII of 2001), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and
commencement,---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Gomal Zam Project (Control and Prevention of Speculation in Land)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. legis.1(28)71/312-17.,

Whereas it is expedient to amend
the North-West Frontier Province Gonial Zam Project (Control and Prevention of
Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XII of 2001), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 4 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. NO.XII of 2001.-In the Gomal Zani Project (Control and
Prevention of Speculation in Land) Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XII of
2001), in section 4, for the word "No", appearing in the beginning,
the words and comma "Except for the purposes of mortgaging with banks and
other financial institutions for obtaining loans, no" shall be
substituted.
